headline: MGM Resorts (NYSE:MGM) Beats Q2 CY2026 Sales Expectations
summary: Hospitality and casino entertainment company MGM Resorts (NYSE:MGM) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 1% year on year to $4.45 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.59 per share was 1.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headline: Susquehanna Maintains Positive on MGM Resorts International, Raises Price Target to $53
summary: Susquehanna  analyst Joseph Stauff   maintains MGM Resorts International (NYSE:MGM) with a Positive and raises the price target from $52 to $53.
